families.theory: Stop orders cluster beyond the previous day's extremes (Osler 2003); a sweep that closes back inside has exhausted that liquidity and tends to revert.
London breakouts of the Asian range that fail trap breakout traders; their exits push price back across the range.
A displacement candle reveals one-sided order flow (an imbalance); a shallow first pullback is absorbed by it.
Liquidity providers absorb temporary imbalances; without a trend, large deviations from the day's average traded price partly revert. (Tick-weighted proxy: no exchange volume available.)
Volatility clusters: low volatility is followed by expansion, and the first range escape sets its direction.
Time-series momentum from slow information diffusion and trend-following flows (Moskowitz, Ooi & Pedersen 2012).
Return autocorrelation after large moves is market specific (continuation from information, reversal from liquidity shocks); the direction is taken from the TRAIN-period structure only.
Overnight information is priced at the cash open; the opening range breakout follows the dominant early order flow.
Early-session returns predict the last half hour to hour (Gao, Han, Li & Zhou 2018): late informed and hedging flows trade in the direction of the open.
A quiet Asian session leaves orders resting at its range; London liquidity breaks it with follow-through.
A strong London move continues into the London/New York overlap as US participants join the trend.
An extended London move is partly reversed at the New York open as European positions are closed.
A break of the previous day's extreme that holds on its retest marks acceptance at new prices.
Previous-week extremes are widely watched: rejection (fade) or acceptance (continuation).

quant.regime_selector: per instrument, map each regime to the base family with the best TRAIN expectancy in it (>= 30 train trades in that regime, E > 0); trade only those (family, regime) pairs
quant.ensemble_2of_n: take a base-family signal only if a DIFFERENT family signalled the same direction within the previous 4 M15 bars (causal agreement), exit 2R
quant.logit_h1: per-instrument L2 logistic regression on H1 features (4 return lags, EMA20/50 distance, RSI, ADX, ATR ratio, hour) predicting the 4-bar return sign; trained on train only; trade p > 0.56 / < 0.44, stop 1 ATR
